title: Change declaration - permission-set-key-replacement
description: governance/change-declarations/<declaration-key>.yml with kind: permission-set-key-replacement - governed intent for the two-PR additive permission-set key replacement (T05 #7 d4; T21 #20 d9; T06 #8 d5), never approval evidence. Phase introduce authorizes creates only (parallel assignments; old resources retained); phase retire requires an immutable reference to verified introduce-phase completion evidence and an explicit destroy acknowledgement, and authorizes retiring only the old assignments and old permission set. The schema requires those retire-phase fields structurally; verification of introduce-phase completion itself is plan-gate GOV-DECL-MATCH work (T06 #8 d5; declaration-vocabulary amendment 2.2/4), never established by this schema. No approved_by, approval timestamps, GroupIds, ARNs, or account IDs (GOV-DECLARATION).

schema_version.description: Declaration schema version (T06 #8 d5); the current version is 1 and changes atomically with this schema (T14 #19 d8).

key.description: Stable declaration key; equals the filename stem exactly.

owner.description: A T06 #8 principal key (declared ownership, not approval).

change_reference.description: Immutable reference to the change this declaration authorizes (issue/PR URL or equivalent immutable identifier).

deployment_scope.description: The permitted deployment scope of the exceptional operation.

valid_until.description: Mandatory; indefinite declarations are prohibited and expired declarations fail closed (T06 #8 d5).

affected_paths.description: The governed paths this declaration covers.

expected_plan_effect_class.description: The T20 #22 d5 fixed classes: creates-only when phase is introduce; deletes-only when phase is retire (declaration-vocabulary amendment, correction D2; GOV-DECL-MATCH).

lab_exception_reference.description: Applicable lab-exception reference, if any (T06 #8 d5).

introduce_completion_evidence.description: Immutable reference to verified introduce-phase completion evidence; required for phase retire.

destroy_acknowledgement.description: Explicit destroy acknowledgement; required for phase retire.
